prompt: A can complete a job alone in 6 days and B can complete the same job alone in 12 days. They start working together, but A leaves after 2 days and B finishes the job alone. How many days does the job take in total?
trap_note: Together they work at 1/6 + 1/12 = 1/4 per day, so 2 days completes half. B alone finishes the remaining half at 1/12 per day, taking 6 more days: 8 in total. Applying the COMBINED rate to the remainder gives 2 more days and a total of 4 -- the departure is the step the chain drops.
